reason: The done-gate blocked this session three times: no check ran after the commit, the engine was not installed in the fresh cloud container, and a long fast-checks run was left unfinished while the agent tried to end. The repo's own gate decides finish; no existing skill says how to run it in a cloud container or what to do when it fails.
CP-12's bin/check failed twice on rules that are easy to miss: an undeclared cross-workflow import and pyright narrowing. Each cost a full check round; the skill's gate guidance does not name either.
